cousin of CMY

She was the youngest daughter of the Rev.

Charles Crawley (cousin of WCY) and his wife, WCY\'s sister Catharina (Yonge) Crawley.

She married (30 Aug 1860) her cousin John Duke Pode (nephew of WCY).
